name: 3rd party - regions
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3rd party - regions.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Informational messages from your published supplier metaobject and selected Markets country. This does not validate shipping rates, inventory, fulfillment, duties or checkout eligibility. Configure a list of ISO two-letter region_country_codes; legacy comma-separated text is accepted.
